reference_inspection: exploratory; reference prefixes inspected before scoring policy

interpretation.columns: Unix timestamp seconds, tx ty tz metres, qx qy qz qw; following TUM syntax by explicit assumption, not a claim of an author-declared format.
interpretation.pose: Assume reference-world-from-LiDAR; archive-specific body-axis/extrinsic convention remains unverified. All pose errors are conditional on this assumption.
interpretation.time: Exact decimal seconds converted to int64 nanoseconds without floating Unix seconds; fixed zero offset from estimate scan-end point time. No offset search or nearest-only association.
interpretation.scale_and_extrinsic: One fixed unit scale and identity estimate/reference body transform, both declared rather than fitted. No GT-driven clock, scale, axis or extrinsic selection.

unresolved_provenance: No located primary document explicitly specifies the archive column convention, transform direction/body axes, or numerical clock/extrinsic mapping. A TUM-like file alone is not proof of these properties.
declared_initial_state: first IMU header, identity pose, zero world velocity/bias, gravity [0,0,-9.80665], acceleration scale9.80665, identity IMU-from-LiDAR
scope: Arithmetic under declared reference body/clock/layout assumptions on an uncalibrated frozen frontend. No validated physical accuracy, improvement, GLIM comparison, runtime or adoption claim.
